independent_computation.reasoning: Every derivation route allowed by the runbook terminates without a value. The leaf sits under /metadata/, its name ('fingerprint/entries') and its scenario's name ('shape counter') both describe bookkeeping over the snapshot's own structure, and such a counter is defined only by the emitting code. Its correct value is whatever the snapshot's structure actually is at HEAD — a fact readable only from scripts/golden_baseline.json and src/, both outside this oracle's evidence tree by construction. Consequently this oracle can neither corroborate nor falsify 19. The one datum that could in principle have contradicted the new value (data/runes.json holding exactly 17 entries at HEAD, per data/README.md) is not linkable to this leaf by any evidence available here, so it does not constitute a contradiction — only an unresolved coincidence worth flagging to the parent, which can check whether the fingerprint is computed over the rune roster.

verdict_qualification: NON-FALSIFICATION, NOT CORROBORATION. This oracle found no evidence contradicting 19 and no evidence supporting 17 over 19; the leaf is outside the domain any wiki-cache/math-doc oracle can adjudicate. The runbook's three-way enum has no 'unverifiable' option, and asserting old_value_correct or both_wrong would be a positive claim this investigation cannot support, so the recorded new value is left standing. The parent must NOT read this as independent confirmation of 19: a /metadata/fingerprint/entries count is validated by inspecting the snapshot's own structure at HEAD (scripts/golden_baseline.json + the emitting code), which is exactly what this oracle is forbidden to do.
flag_to_parent: Only unresolved coincidence: data/runes.json contains exactly 17 entries at HEAD and data/README.md pins that roster at 17. If the fingerprint's 'entries' is computed over the rune roster (or any other cached-data roster) rather than over the snapshot's output shape, then 19 contradicts the cache and the correct value would be 17. Confirm what the fingerprint enumerates before accepting the +2.
